newsitem.title: SPAIN: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.
newsitem.headline: Peseta debt/interbank market closing report.

text.p: Spanish government bonds were locked in a very narrow trading range on Monday and closed almost unchanged after a dull day, traders said.
"We saw very little on the market," a dealer at Fimat said. "We limited ourselves to follow Italian Btps and nothing else."
He added that the market, at least on the domestic side, was focusing on October inflation data, scheduled for November 14.
A Reuter poll among 16 financial experts forecast October CPI up 0.2 percent month-on-month and up 3.6 percent year-on-year, compared with 0.2 and 3.6 percent respectively in September.
